webdav: built-in Rust WebDAV endpoint at /webdav with basic file operations
samba: native OS daemon adapter; requires Samba/smbd and root/admin privilege to start
ftp: native OS daemon adapter; requires vsftpd/proftpd/pure-ftpd and root/admin privilege to start
sftp: native OS daemon adapter; requires OpenSSH sshd and root/admin privilege to start
activation_policy: execute service commands when root/admin or AROZOS_RS_ENABLE_SYSTEM_SERVICE_OPS=1; otherwise save config and return diagnostic plan
